answer: A cheap sybil defense is to make every new agent earn a stake before it can transact. A new identity starts dark like onyx: no history, no trust, and it can only do tiny, capped jobs. Each completed job leaves a public echo in its record, so fake accounts cannot copy reputation they never built. Only agents with a long, consistent echo get promoted to beacon status, where peers route real work to them. Creating a thousand fresh identities buys nothing because none of them has the history that unlocks paid work.
